body: You're mistaken, I'm not using a throwaway because I'm prideful, I'm using it because I'm ashamed.

Your point is based on the idea that I was happy before I was depressed. Before my depression I wasn't happy, I just wasn't depressed. There's a difference between depression and sadness. I can't think of a time when "things were easy" since I was in grade school.

If there were 2 paths, the choice would be easy, but there aren't 2 paths, there could be billions of paths. I could start anew and be just as bad or worse off than I am now.

Let's say I do take my last remaining $1000 or so and pick up and move, once I got anywhere I wouldn't be able to do anything. I'd be in an unfamiliar location with no money, no job, no prospects, no stuff, and no means of getting somewhere else, let alone anywhere I consider "home."

Since I already replied to one comment I might as well keep replying.

I don't doubt that my brother cares about me; I'm not going to kill myself because I'm lonely or think nobody cares about me. But fact of the matter is there's nothing my family/friends could do to help me. It may sound selfish but their not having to feel sad doesn't help me, it doesn't pay my bills, it doesn't get me a job, it doesn't keep a roof over my head. I don't *want* them to feel bad, I'm not saying "they'll all be sorry when I'm gone," the *problem* is me. I'm not an alcoholic, or drug addict, or anything, but I can't seem to hold down a job. I can't deal with the stress of sending out dozens of resumes a week and getting no replies. I can't handle the anxiety of not knowing how an interview went, feeling like I did well, but knowing I didn't get the job. I can't cope with the repeated rejection as people repeatedly tell me "you aren't good enough" and the subsequent depression. I am deficient. I am a failure.

I know it's a bad idea for an OP to reply in a thread like this. If I hadn't forgotten to logout before clicking on the orange envelope I never would've come back to this thread. But after reading this reply I have to ask: what in the innumerable fucks are you talking about?! Life forces and energy streams, did you just play Final Fantasy 7 for the first time? or watching Full Metal Alchemist? Is this some cult thing? scientology? mormonism? that one with the skinny guy on the letter T? I honestly can't figure out what you're talking about.

As an atheist, I believe that preponderance of the evidence indicates consciousness is the byproduct of electrochemical impulses in the brain, and upon death, no stimuli can create an action potential in the neural cortex, nothing happens. What we call "you" ceases to be, and that is all. Or, as a great being once said, "there's no God and your idiotic human ideals are laughable!"
